sentences.text: In the Universal Century, not every mobile suit gets to be the hero's machine.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s01.wav

sentences.text: R-X zero N, the Banshee Norn, Goddess of Fate: the Earth Federation's second answer to the riddle of the Unicorn.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s02.wav

sentences.text: Like the Unicorn, she carries a psycho-frame, armor that answers a Newtype's will.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s03.wav

sentences.text: When the N-T-D system awakens, the mask splits, the frame burns green, and a machine of order starts to look disturbingly alive.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s04.wav

sentences.text: Her pilot is no chosen one. Riddhe Marcenas, a Federation ace, fighting for duty rather than destiny.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s05.wav

sentences.text: While Banagher rides the Unicorn toward answers, Riddhe is ordered to silence them.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s06.wav

sentences.text: The two machines were built as sisters. In the dark of space they do not simply fight. As the line goes: the Unicorn and the Banshee are pulling on each other.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s07.wav

sentences.text: And when the psycho-frame screams, it is not a curse. It was a prayer.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s08.wav

sentences.text: Near the end, sensors report resonance beyond every measurable limit, as if countless hearts were sounding at once.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s09.wav

sentences.text: She was built to bury the secret of Laplace.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s10.wav

sentences.text: In the end, even the Federation's sharpest spear could not stop the truth being born. We were blessed when we were born.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s11.wav

sentences.text: The Banshee Norn: the reluctant angel of the Universal Century.
sentences.file: 工作台/banshee-intro-001/G2-证据与口播/配音试听-Samantha/s12.wav
